title: Basic String Operations
title_vi: Các Thao Tác Chuỗi Cơ Bản Trong Shell

sections.title: Introduction

verification.command:
python3 - <<'LABEX_CHECK'
import os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
p=pathlib.Path('/home/labex/project/string_operations.sh')
assert p.is_file(), 'Create the requested file first'
text=p.read_text()
assert all(token in text for token in ['#!/bin/bash']), 'Required concepts missing'
if False: assert os.access(p,os.X_OK), 'Add execute permission'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='labex-shell-check-') as directory:
    work=pathlib.Path(directory)
    source=p
    if p.suffix == '.sh':
        p=work/source.name
        # Preserve teaching delays in the learner file; suppress sleep only in
        # this isolated behavior probe so a five-second loop does not time out.
        p.write_text(text if False else text.replace('sleep 1', ':').replace('sleep 2', ':'))
        p.chmod(0o700)
        assert subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-n',str(p)],capture_output=True).returncode == 0
    def execute(arguments, data=''):
        return subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',*arguments],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,cwd=work,timeout=2)
    result=execute([str(p),*[]],'')
    assert all(item in result.stdout for item in []),result.stdout
LABEX_CHECK

sections.title: Finding Character Position
sections.content:
Find j in the alphabet with expr index; indexing starts at 1.

`~/project/string_operations.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
STRING="Hello, World!"
LENGTH=${#STRING}
echo "The string is: $STRING"
echo "Its length is: $LENGTH"

STRING="abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
CHAR="j"
POSITION=$(expr index "$STRING" "$CHAR")
echo "It is at position: $POSITION"
```

sections.title: Substring Extraction
sections.content:
Extract five characters at offset 10; Bash offsets start at zero.

`~/project/string_operations.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
STRING="Hello, World!"
LENGTH=${#STRING}
echo "The string is: $STRING"
echo "Its length is: $LENGTH"

STRING="abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
CHAR="j"
POSITION=$(expr index "$STRING" "$CHAR")
echo "It is at position: $POSITION"

STRING="The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"

LENGTH=5
```

sections.title: String Replacement
sections.content:
Compare first/all replacements and anchored prefix/suffix replacement.

`~/project/string_operations.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
STRING="Hello, World!"
LENGTH=${#STRING}
echo "The string is: $STRING"
echo "Its length is: $LENGTH"

STRING="abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
CHAR="j"
POSITION=$(expr index "$STRING" "$CHAR")
echo "It is at position: $POSITION"

STRING="The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"
START=10
LENGTH=5
SUBSTRING=${STRING:$START:$LENGTH}
echo "The substring is: $SUBSTRING"

STRING="The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"
echo "${STRING/o/O}"
echo "${STRING//o/O}"
echo "${STRING/#The quick/The slow}"
echo "${STRING/%dog/cat}"
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/string_operations.sh

```

```bash
LENGTH=${#STRING}
echo "The string is: $STRING"
echo "Its length is: $LENGTH"

STRING="abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
CHAR="j"
POSITION=$(expr index "$STRING" "$CHAR")
echo "It is at position: $POSITION"

STRING="The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"
START=10
LENGTH=5
SUBSTRING=${STRING:$START:$LENGTH}
echo "The substring is: $SUBSTRING"

STRING="The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"
echo "${STRING/o/O}"
echo "${STRING//o/O}"
echo "${STRING/#The quick/The slow}"
echo "${STRING/%dog/cat}"
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/string_operations.sh
~/project/string_operations.sh 
```
